Regarding the operational processes described in the text, the primary bottleneck is the inefficient layout of the central tool and material repository. The significant travel distances required for workers to retrieve items are causing lost productivity. To improve efficiency, AutoBuild should consider decentralizing resources by establishing smaller, localized storage points closer to specific construction areas, or implementing a just-in-time delivery system to bring materials directly to the workers, thereby minimizing transit time and maximizing productive labor hours.
